name: obsigama
description: OBSIGAMA: a game hub for Obsidian. Accounts, profiles, library and leaderboards on Supabase, plus an SDK for game plugins.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.typecheck: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && npm run typecheck -w packages/sdk && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck -p examples/tsconfig.json
